description: Stretches or shrinks the DURATION of a grainy sound without stretching the grains themselves: only the onset-to-onset (intergrain) times are multiplied by ratio, so every attack keeps its natural speed and timbre - like playing the same phrase faster or slower on the same instrument. The exact output rule, verified sample-close on three click trains: outdur = ratio x (last grain onset - first grain onset) + (indur - that span). The entry's 'indur * ratio' model is the honest approximation for material whose grains cover the file; it under/over-predicts by (ratio-1) x (uncovered head+tail) - observed -5% at ratio 2 and -6.7% at ratio 3 on a train with a 0.2 s tail, and it FAILS COMPLETELY on sounds with fewer than two detected grains (flat noise: output = input exactly, any ratio; see known_issues). Any intergrain time that would fall below MINGRAINTIME (0.032 s) is set to 0.032. Deterministic; mono and stereo accepted.
musical_use: Event-level rubato and tempo change. Ratio below 1 packs the attacks into a denser, faster gestural stream (accelerando at .5 halves the gaps); above 1 opens air between events without any pitch or timbral cost - the anti-timestretch, since stretch time and modify speed both smear or transpose attacks. The breakpoint form is where it becomes a phrasing tool (banner: brk times refer to INFILE time): ramp 1 -> 2 for a written-out ritardando, step between fixed ratios to recompose a rhythm grid, dip below 1 mid-file for a surge. Combine with grain rerhythm (explicit per-gap multipliers from a data file) when you want patterned rather than continuous retiming. Get the gate right first (see grain reverse) - undetected grains simply don't move.

ratio.description: Multiplier on the intergrain (onset-to-onset) times: 2 doubles them, 0.5 halves them (CDP-enforced range quoted 'Parameter[1] Value (...) out of range (0.001000 to 1000.000000)'). Intergrain times shrunk below 0.032 s are clamped to 0.032. Breakpoint-CAPABLE, banner-confirmed ('Timestretch-ratio and Gate may vary over time. Times in brkpnt files refer to INFILE time.'): a 0.5->2 ramp exits 0 (2.18 s from 2 s) and differs from both endpoint renders.

len.description: Maximum time between grains in seconds (CDP-enforced 0.1 to the input duration, 'Parameter[2] Value (0.001000) out of range (0.100000 to 2.000000)' on a 2 s file). Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 3 [...]: brkpnt_files not permitted.').

gate.description: Required signal level for a grain to be seen (CDP-enforced 0-1). Real default 0.3 (manual; the banner's 'default 1' is wrong for this family). Breakpoint-capable (gate ramp exits 0; banner-confirmed).

minhole.description: Minimum duration of inter-grain holes (CDP-enforced 0.032 - the default - to the input duration). Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 5 [...]: brkpnt_files not permitted.').

winsize.description: Envelope-tracking window in ms for a signal-tracking gate; 0 = off (CDP-enforced 0 to the input duration in ms). Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 6 [...]: brkpnt_files not permitted.').

ignore_last.description: Ignore the last grain in the source (verified: 3.59 s instead of 3.80 s at ratio 2). Must follow the value flags (CDP flag-order enforcement).

examples.description: Half-speed feel: double every gap between attacks, attacks untouched.
examples.expected_use: Output roughly 2x the input duration on well-covered grainy material (less the unstretched head/tail).

examples.description: Written-out ritardando: ratio ramps 1.0 to 2.0 across the file.
examples.expected_use: Gradual deceleration of the event stream (write rit.brk with breakpoint(); brk times are INFILE time).

known_issues: Duration honesty: the exact rule (verified to the sample on 10-, 15- and 20-grain trains) is outdur = ratio x (grain-onset span) + (indur - span); the modelled 'indur * ratio' is exact only when grains span the whole file. Observed errors: -2.5% (dense train, ratio 2), -5.0% (0.2 s tail, ratio 2), -6.7% (ratio 3), +10% relative at ratio 0.5. Budget accordingly when chaining.

On material where the gate finds fewer than two grains (flat noise, sustained tones) the process exits 0 and returns the input UNCHANGED - ratio has no effect and the duration model over/under-predicts by the full ratio factor. The duration-model fixture's flat-noise input only passes at ratio 1.0 (findings row pinned there); verify real use on grainy material.
Intergrain times reduced below MINGRAINTIME 0.032 s are silently clamped to 0.032 (banner-documented), so extreme shrink ratios bottom out instead of stacking grains.
DIVERGENCE: banner gate 'default 1' vs real default 0.3; manual len minimum '1' vs enforced 0.1 (family-wide).
afta8's ratio max of 50 is an advisory subset - CDP enforces 0.001 to 1000.
-x must follow the value flags (CDP flag-order enforcement).
